verdict.rationale: Sentry's CLI is documented for release management, Sentry surfaces suspect commits alongside stack traces, and the Bitbucket Pipelines integration notifies Sentry of new builds. Together these suggest regressions can be tied to code releases and deploys. Configuration-change correlation is only loosely implied by the LaunchDarkly integration, which sends Sentry errors into experiments rather than tracking flag changes inside Sentry. Missing for 10: explicit docs on release or deploy tracking that links regressions to specific deploys, any evidence of tracking configuration or feature-flag changes within Sentry, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
